verdicts.title: The 'Core' of Symmetric Homogeneous Polynomial Inequalities of Degree Four of Three Real Variables

The main theorems describe the cases in which the smallest possible coefficient is not expressed by the other coefficients. The problem is resolved by introducing a parametric representation.
